# DC Department of Employment Services (DOES)

> > The DC Department of Employment Services provides employer and agent self-service portals for managing employment-related services and compliance.

DOES operates digital platforms enabling employers and authorized agents to access employment services online. The portal supports modern web browsers including Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, ensuring broad accessibility for DC businesses and employment service providers.

## Key Topics

- Department of Employment Services
- DOES
- Employer Portal
- Agent Portal
- Self-Service
- Login
- Employer Services

- Firefox
- Microsoft Edge

## Employer & Agent Portal

- [DOES - Employer & Agent Portal](https://essp.does.dc.gov): Self-service portal for employers and agents to access DOES services, manage accounts, and handle employment-related transactions
